item.title: Crackme: bswap then xor
item.description:
Crackme (Windows x64, arg in ecx):
mov eax, ecx bswap eax xor eax, 0FFh cmp eax, 123456AAh sete al movzx eax, al ret
Which value of ecx makes the function return 1? Give it in decimal (and hex).
Answer: 1431712786 (0x55563412) 1. bswap eax reverses the four bytes (endianness swap): 0xAABBCCDD becomes 0xDDCCBBAA. It is its own inverse. 2. The check needs bswap(ecx) ^ 0xFF == 0x123456AA, so bswap(ecx) = 0x12345655. 3. Undo the swap by reversing the bytes again: ecx = 0x55563412. The solution is unique, since xor and bswap are bijections.
